g.desc: The server uses the virtual IP address (VIP) as a default gat...
g.text: The server uses the virtual IP address (VIP) as a default gateway.

g.title: Sheet.196
g.desc: The routers share a common virtual IP address (VIP) in an act...
g.text: The routers share a common virtual IP address (VIP) in an active-standby manner. If the active router fails, the other automatically takes over.
